title: Isihlwele Esinyamaleleyo
intro: Umi phambi kweengxolo zoluntu olunebali elibhalwe emaza. Le miphefumlo yeva ubizo, yakhetha ukungathobeli, yaza yajongana nesiphumo esatshintsha umhlaba. Ngoobani, kwaye kwenzeka ntoni kwihlabathi labo?
clues: Sasiphila kudala, kwaza kwafika umthunywa kuthi evela phakathi kwethu.
Sasinqula izithixo ezintlanu saza sala ukuzishiya.
Simhleka usulu umthunywa waza wamtyhola ngokuba uyaphambuka.
Sasifuna ukuba anike isohlwayo ukuba uthetha inyani.
Sibone isibhakabhaka sichitha imvula nomhlaba ukhupha imithombo.
Sanyuka saya kwiindawo eziphakamileyo ukuze sibaleke, kodwa amaza asifumana.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Sonke satshabalala ngaphandle kwabakholwayo kunye noNuh
outcome.answer: Sonke satshabalala ngaphandle kwabakholwayo kunye noNuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
